seed_search_scope: No matches in current tracked experiments/scripts/docs/.github; not a claim about unregistered external runs
smoke_reuse: Smoke is a five-iteration prefix check of the first registered seed, not independent evidence; never exchange it after inspection
mutation_seed: same as creation seed for every exploration condition and both designer controls
oracle: forbidden in exploration, critique, mutation and acceptance; no complete graph built
gate: Exact original JSON reproduction; float-only discrepancies reported separately but do not silently pass. Then interface and unchanged-structural checks. Then six smoke runs without exceptions and with replay audits. No performance gate.
failure: preserve traceback and partial files; no seed replacement, alternative designer, outcome tuning, or resource-failure-as-policy-failure
metrics: unchanged V2 metrics; state_coverage and edge_coverage are observed counts, not true total coverage fractions
comparison_unit: creation seed; 50 deterministic self-play trials are not independent worlds
inference: descriptive paired seed differences, all seeds and regressions; no post-hoc superiority threshold
timing: single worker per condition, BLAS/OMP/MKL=1; recorder cost included; no composite score combining CPU and game quality
